rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Payload {
    meta:
        description = "Detects encrypted Cobalt Strike beacon stage in memory or traffic"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $a = { 2d 30 2e 30 2e 30 2e 30 2d } // "-0.0.0.0-" pattern in beacon config
        $b = { 6b 65 72 62 65 72 6f 73 } // "kerberos" in lowercase
        $c = { 47 45 54 20 2f [1-10] 20 48 54 54 50 } // GET /<path> HTTP
    condition:
        all of them
}

arguments.summary: Privilege escalation incident on host WS-IT-101 (10.0.1.25) via PrintNightmare (CVE-2021-34527). Exploitation originated from compromised workstation WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), attributed to user CORP\jsmith. The attacker used Cobalt Strike beaconing to establish C2, performed lateral movement via SMB, and leveraged the svc_print_mgmt service account for privilege escalation. The malicious DLL was loaded from C:\Windows\Temp\malicious.dll by spoolsv.exe. No malware was detected post-containment. The source IP 10.0.5.14 (C2 infrastructure) has been blocked at the firewall.
